components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.4); border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; transition: background-color 0.3s, border-color 0.3s, transform 0.3s; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-card:hover { background: rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.6); border-color: #3f3f46; transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-header { margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-badge { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); color: #34d399; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card-title { color: #f4f4f5; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-desc { color: #a1a1aa; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0 0 16px 0; } .ds-card-footer { border-top: 1px solid #27272a; padding-top: 16px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-author { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-author-avatar { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4f46e5, #7c3aed); color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; } .ds-author-name { color: #d4d4d8; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-author-email { color: #52525b; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-card-link { color: #818cf8; text-decoration: none; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-card-link:hover { color: #a5b4fc; }

narrative.overview: NestPost Hub utilizes a dark, focused user interface designed to mirror a modern code editor environment. The system leans heavily on deep zinc shades, crisp 1px borders, and translucent layered surfaces to establish a clean hierarchical layout. High-fidelity indigo and violet accents serve to highlight interactive targets and key metadata without overstimulating the user's attention.
keyCharacteristics: Deep dark backdrop with a clean gray color scale (zinc).
High-fidelity indigo/violet accents (used selectively at ≤10% visual area).
Flat surface containers defined by precise 1px borders and alpha-blended transparency.
Technical typography (Geist Sans) coupled with monospace metadata (Geist Mono).

rules.name: The 10% Accent Rule
rules.body: The vibrant indigo/violet accent colors must only occupy ≤10% of any given screen's total visual area. Their impact comes from rarity, drawing the eye directly to action points.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain flat and unshaded at rest. Drop shadows are forbidden except on active overlays (such as modals or absolute dropdowns) which use a heavy ambient dark shadow to isolate them from underlying text.

dos: Do stick to a maximum 75ch line length limit on article content to optimize readability.
Do use Geist Mono for code snippets, IDs, connection states, and email addresses.
Do respect system-level preferences by disabling slide/fade animations if prefers-reduced-motion is active.
donts: Don't use colored side-stripe borders (e.g. border-left-4) as accents on list items or cards.
Don't use gradient text combinations under dark modes; use clean white or solid light gray text instead.
Don't use generic, unstyled cards. Always include the explicit 1px zinc-850 border and translucent background.
